description: Selected executed runtime checks. Source/build/runtime revisions are distinct. Scenario mapping is reviewed against actual assertions, not inferred from case labels. Raw evidence is private; original result hashes permit local provenance checks. This file does not replace the acceptance status table.

runs.scope: Controlled actual equipment transport, process restart, immutable command conflicts and missing history. Historical tested image identities are retained below.

cases.name: execution with a lost response resolves through the original command
retained absence permits a resend with the same ID
simulator process restart during execution preserves atomic physical history
HISTORY_GAP: role/site checks and audited investigation preserve one effect
WORLD_MISMATCH: role/site checks and audited investigation preserve one effect
adapter and simulator independently reject changed immutable command payloads

runs.scope: Unstarted cancellation, started-work barrier, concurrent supervisors and one stock release; actual local PKCE UI.

started work refuses cancellation, retains stock and completes exactly once
concurrent requests and changed-key payload cannot duplicate reservation release

cases.name: owner storage diagnostics are readable with the platform role

cases.name: controlled critical gate refuses intake and dispatch, retains accepted stock and resumes one effect

independent execution consumer observes other-owner assignments without tasks and enforces site/DDL boundaries

runs.scope: Concurrent supervisors, unknown command barrier and finite old-owner drain before retained pending work obtains the new epoch.

unknown/later quarantined command blocks reversal beyond the transport timeout; waiting grants no ownership authority
original allocated work completes under execution ownership, pending work moves once to the reversed legacy epoch, and retained uncertain history is reconciled without redispatch

runs.scope: Independent product counts, new-event-ID business duplicates, mixed destinations, other-product availability and actual returns process outage.

cases.name: mixed receipt, concurrent business duplicates and different event IDs have single independent effects
local human roles, site isolation, bounded input and runtime DDL denial
returns and compatible alternate outbound lanes continue during one outbound lane fault
outbound keeps working during returns process outage; returns retains its original task and receipt
returns lost response reconciles one physical sorting effect

cases.name: restored identity and both product read APIs work through the documented local forward

cases.name: restoration stop and preserved-primary resume keep original storage and physical history

runs.scope: Actual isolated broker process outage, bounded HTTP intake refusal, preserved backlog and single effects after PVC restart.

runs.scope: Deployed shadow intake denial with permitted snapshot read, all six owner APIs, cryptographically verified wrong-audience token, actual expiry/refresh, source forgery and mutual TLS.

runs.scope: Actual independent adapter, database and all-four-monitoring process outages; five, five and 25 retained single effects respectively; unavailable database intake returns 503 without creating an order.

Application PostgreSQL independently restarts on the same PVCs; recorded responses and five accepted effects survive. Unavailable intake creates no order.
cases.scope: Database process replacement; separate application and broker evidence completes A45.

cases.name: All four monitoring processes are absent while both products commit 25 single movements; business pods survive and scrapes recover.

runs.scope: Actual 10000/1000 quorum queue limits, publisher NACK, retained original source and queue head, duplicate drain, independent shadow capacity, supervisor replay and five single effects.

cases.part: Critical quorum queue rejects publishers, preserves the pre-overflow head and source bytes, and drains duplicates with single physical/sorting effects.
A full independent shadow queue does not block either product; exhausted original observations resume through versioned, idempotent supervisor audit without command authority.

runs.scope: Current runtime actual core halt at three commit/confirmation/acknowledgement boundaries; retained original work, duplicate transport and single effects.
